Additionally, the campus will include power generation and compute testing facilities that will enable fully optimized development, operation, and testing of the fabrication facility and its products. This position requires a dedicated safety leader who will be able to use their skill, knowledge, and experience to further our Environmental Health and Safety programs within our fast-paced work environment that includes operations that have never been attempted before. You will bring deep experience in EHS risk assessment, industrial hygiene, environmental compliance, and equipment, process, and construction safety. You will have the opportunity to build and lead a talented team of EHS managers, specialists, and engineers. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. SENIOR GRAPHIC DESIGNER As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will be responsible for leading the creative development and execution of a wide range of visual design projects with the ultimate goal of inspiring and educating the public. This position will play a critical role in bringing to life visual representations for both external and internal needs and require a keen eye for detail and execution. RESPONSIBILITIES: Partner with the Communications, Content and Creative teams in producing assets across multiple platforms (print, digital, webcast and experiential graphic design). Sketch, storyboard, ideate, and generate new concepts based on stakeholder direction and self-driven research. Own the creative process from design to execution on projects both internal and external facing. Maintain the visual aesthetic of the brand. Lead and manage projects ranging from simple design requests to managing complex print-ready materials. BASIC REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree. 5+ years of professional design experience in illustration, graphic design, or print production. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, art, web design, or advertising. 8+ years of digital graphic/visual design experience, preferably in a creative digital agency setting working on digital products. Experience with client management and full-cycle production of original content. Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects). Expertise in visual quality assurance (VQA) of image size format, color format, and file delivery format. Proficiency in PowerPoint and/or Keynote. Proficiency with Figma. Experience with image optimizing, retouching, manipulation, color corrections. Experience in design, layout, color, and typography to art direct or produce digital assets, partnering with Product Designers. Experience creating 2D digital assets/iconography. Experience with animation, motion design, motion graphics work, and dynamic interactions. Experience in industrial design or working with industrial designers. Experience with UX/UI design. Experience in printer spec language and output as well as working with outside print vendors and digital production. Strong visual and conceptual skills to solve problems and create novel solutions. Typeface and or illustration design skills. Knowledgeable in industry standard digital production technologies for pixel-perfect branded design assets for web and apps. A growing ability to develop innovative design work across all media. Resourcefulness and ability to locate and archive assets independently. Able to multi-task on design projects with a tireless work ethic. Ability to work collaboratively with cross functional teams. Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills. Ability to maintain composure and articulate directives in an open, ever changing, fast paced environment. Ability to stay organized, meet deadlines, and prioritize projects based on the business calendar. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Online portfolio and any supplemental samples of work in a PDF required for consideration. A portfolio is required with examples of graphic design, motion design, and iconography assets. Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends to accommodate prototyping and product launch campaigns. This is not a remote position and will require relocation if not already local to the Hawthorne, CA area. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. basic_qualifications: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. NETWORK SOFTWARE INTEGRATION ENGINEER (STARLINK) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Network Software Integration Engineer on the Starlink program, you will develop fast and versatile integrated testing infrastructure that rethinks traditional CI/CD pipelines. Our goal is to provide customers with the best possible satellite internet experience, which is enabled by SpaceX's rapid development and testing iteration cycle. You will be working to test and integrate a range of network software features that deploy worldwide to Starlink data centers and Starlink vehicles (satellites, laser terminals, ground stations, and user antennas). You will work closely with a wide variety of developers to validate and deploy cutting edge network features, through end-to-end integration environments to find issues and regression proof the Starlink network. RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop fast and reliable integrated test systems architecture for the Starlink network. Work across teams to deliver dynamic and capable end-to-end testing solutions. Debug software and network failures in hardware-in-the-loop test environments. Identify and resolve testing coverage gaps across the network. Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews. Develop tools for software development and deployment, data analysis and visualization, and test execution across multiple environments, including virtualized hardware environments, real hardware-in-the-loop simulations, and on-orbit testing. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in electrical and computer engineering, computer science, physics, or science discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree (internship experience is applicable). Development experience in Python and/or C++. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Developed, debugged, and deployed software that has been used in real world applications/project. Knowledgeable in containerization frameworks (Docker, K8s) and associated tooling. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements. Excellent communication skills both written and verbal. Strong understanding of Linux Operating Systems and bash scripting. Hands on experience with working with OSI-model layer 2 and 3. Hands-on lab experience with familiarity of spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, electrical power equipment and PCBAs. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 Level 2: $145,000.00 - $175,000.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. Experience with dynamic routing (eBGP, iBGP, OSPF, SD-WAN), network segmentation, logging/alerting with SIEMs, and zero-trust architectures. Ability to diagnose low-level connectivity and performance issues and to work effectively with stakeholders and end users. Self-starter with excellent time-management, communication (written and verbal), and collaboration skills; mid-career professional who has successfully owned similar infrastructure or remote-access initiatives.
